meta.name: Floreasca
meta.osm: OpenStreetMap API 0.6 /map tiles fetched 2026-11-06 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Every object keyed by OSM id (w=way, n=node, r=relation).

conventions.side: compass side of the street axis the object is on (N/NE/…)
conventions.lanes: OSM semantics: lanes = total, lanes_forward along way direction (dir = compass of first→last node)
conventions.style_est: heuristic from OSM tags (year/levels/type); research.* overrides
conventions.storeys_est: only when OSM has no levels/height: median of tagged same-type neighbours <90 m, else type default (see storeys_est_src)
conventions.facade_hex_est: district palette pick by style/type — an estimate, not an observation
conventions.colours: hex sRGB; *_est = estimated from district style rule, research.facade_hex = observed/sourced

sources.osm: https://www.openstreetmap.org (API 0.6 map tiles, 2026-11-06; tags lanes, turn:lanes, maxspeed, trolley_wire, building:*)

boundary.rationale: Extraction area = world agent bbox from cities.js BUC_DISTRICTS (so every street the world builds is covered). 1.41 km N-S × 0.81 km E-W ≈ 1.14 km²: Calea Floreasca from Piața Floreasca (market, S) to Str. Gheorghe Țițeica (N), the 'composer streets' villa quarter (Mozart, Chopin, Bach, Verdi, Ceaikovski, Garibaldi) east of it, Parcul/Grădina Floreasca west of it; edges on quiet residential streets (Str. Banul Antonache W, Str. Ramuri Tei/Kepler E, Bd. Lacul Tei S-ish). Sky Tower (137 m) and Promenada lie 600 m north — render as skyline backdrop.

chapters.title: Liceul Teoretic C.A. Rosetti

start.desc: WORLD START: Calea Floreasca northbound, 400 m before Piața Floreasca

end.desc: Liceul C.A. Rosetti gate, Str. Garibaldi 11 (one-way northbound; school on the left/W side)

waypoints.desc: WORLD START: Calea Floreasca northbound, 400 m before Piața Floreasca
Liceul C.A. Rosetti gate, Str. Garibaldi 11 (one-way northbound; school on the left/W side)

chapters.why: Start at Piața Floreasca market and drive north up Calea Floreasca (park and old cinema garden on the left, Nusco/One Tower offices, cafes; Sky Tower dead ahead on the skyline) → right into one-way Str. Johann Strauss → Rahmaninov → Georges Bizet through the 1930s composer-street villa grid → left onto one-way Str. Garibaldi north to the school gate.

chapters.title: Deutsche Bank (world pin: Floreasca Park) — see pipera for the real DB building
chapters.why: World chapter as configured: north on Calea Floreasca past Rosetti's quarter and Parcul Floreasca to the Sky Tower / Barbu Văcărescu junction and the cities.js db pin. NOTE research finding: DB Global Technology is actually at BOB Tower, Bd. Dimitrie Pompeiu 6A (pipera).

stops.name: Liceul Teoretic C.A. Rosetti

door.side: W side of a ONE-WAY NORTHBOUND street (address node n7119137467)
door.note: school yard with fence and gate on Garibaldi; Școala Gimnazială "Maria Rosetti" is a different school at Garibaldi 3 — do not confuse

building.facade: 1950s–60s school block: rendered masonry, cream/light-yellow walls (#E8DDB8 est.) with white window frames, regular grid of tall windows, flat or low hipped roof; fenced sports yard
building.seismic: listed by the Ministry of Education among Bucharest school buildings at seismic risk (class not given)

stops.cities_js_check: cities.js rosetti {44.4565, 26.1055} is ~1.2 km SOUTH of the school (it lands near Spitalul Floreasca / Bd. Ștefan cel Mare). Use {44.4671, 26.1062}; Garibaldi is ONE-WAY NORTHBOUND along its whole length (approach from the south or via Bizet/Rahmaninov).

stops.name: DB Global Technology (Deutsche Bank tech centre) — NOT in Floreasca
stops.finding: The DB technology centre opened in 2014 (UpGround/Dimitrie Pompeiu area) and has had its HQ on Bd. Dimitrie Pompeiu since at least 2015 (6,000+ m² on two floors in a building DB sold to Globalworth and leased back); the current careers page lists 6A Dimitrie Pompeiu Blvd, 020337. No source places it in Floreasca Park (Șos. Pipera 43) or at Calea Floreasca 169A (= Floreasca Business Park, tenants Oracle/Xerox/Holcim/GE…).
stops.recommendation: Move chapter `db` (2017) to district `pipera` — the DB building is ~150 m from Hermes Business Campus (luxoft). See bucharest-pipera.md for its route.

research.cross_section: Main N–S artery of the quarter: 2 lanes northbound + 1–2 southbound (OSM lanes 3–5 incl. turn pockets "left|through|through;right"), split into one-way pairs around short islands at Piața Floreasca and Ceaikovski; 50 km/h; kerbside parking lanes (parking=lane) on long stretches; buses 135, 343, 461 (no trolley, no tram)
research.frontage: W side: Piața Floreasca market (S end), Nusco Floreasca 1–2 offices (141-143, 5 lv), Souk (131B), Agora Floreasca mall (111-113), One Tower (151, 16 lv glass, 2020s), Sanador clinic (165), Parcul Floreasca / former Cinema Floreasca park; E side: 3–4-storey 1930s–50s villas and small blocks with shops, cafes and restaurants on the ground floor (Floreasca became a nightlife/food hotspot)
research.trees: mature linden/chestnut rows both sides; park trees on the W side
research.sidewalks: 3–4 m grey pavers (renovated) with cars on the kerb edge in places
research.skyline: Sky Tower (137 m, 37 floors, Romania's tallest) and the Promenada/Floreasca City Center complex 600 m north dominate the view northbound

research.cross_section: mostly one-way single lane, residential; villas + 3–4-storey 1930s blocks
ONE-WAY NORTHBOUND single lane, residential (RO:urban 50, effectively 30), asphalt, cars parked on both sides half on the sidewalk; narrow 1.5–2 m sidewalks with linden/robinia trees
research.frontage: interwar villas (2–3 storeys, stucco, pitched tile roofs, wrought-iron fences) + the C.A. Rosetti school (11) and Maria Rosetti school (3)

research.cross_section: one-way eastbound, single lane; Hotel Johann Strauss (no. 1), 5-storey small blocks

top_local_details: Rosetti is NOT on Calea Floreasca — it is in the villa quarter on Str. Garibaldi 11, ~1.2 km north of the old pin.
Garibaldi and most composer streets are narrow ONE-WAY single-lane streets lined with parked cars.
Sky Tower dominates the northbound view: tallest building in Romania (137 m), glass, rounded, lit crown.
Calea Floreasca has buses only (135/343/461) — no tram, no trolleybus.
Floreasca is leafy: lindens and chestnuts over villa gardens; wrought-iron fences.
1930s villas with red tile roofs, stucco in cream/ochre, many restored, some replaced by boutique blocks.
Ground-floor cafes/restaurants and clinics along Calea Floreasca (Sanador, Medlife, Agora).
Piața Floreasca market at the south end of the avenue.
Parcul Floreasca/grădina on the west side with tall trees.
Nusco and One Tower glass offices on the west side of Calea Floreasca.
Mega Image Maison des Chefs, Garanti bank on Calea Floreasca.
School yard fence and kids crossing at 07:45 and 13:00–14:00.
Cars parked on sidewalks everywhere in the villa grid.
Speed humps/raised zebras around schools (verify).
Calea Floreasca splits into one-way pairs around islands at junctions.
Late-evening crowds and valet parking at restaurants (nightlife hotspot).
No high-rise blocks in the villa grid except a few 4–5-storey ones.
Promenada mall and Floreasca Park office campus lie further north.
Lake Floreasca west of the district (strand/sports complex).
Overhead cables and older concrete lamp posts on side streets.
Red seismic-risk plaques on some older blocks.
Hotel Johann Strauss at the corner of Str. Johann Strauss.
Yellow taxis and Bolt/Uber cars idling at restaurants.
Kerbside parking lanes on Calea Floreasca.
Pedestrian signals with countdowns at Ceaikovski.
Embassy residences and guard booths are common in the area.
Calm, low traffic inside the grid; queues only on Calea Floreasca.
Street-name plates are blue with white text.
Gated driveways with sliding metal gates.
Autumn: chestnut leaves pile on the sidewalks.

driving.note: RO:urban default 50; several boulevards signed 60 (OSM maxspeed=60 on Lascăr Catargiu, Magheru, Dorobanți north).

markings.lane_line: white dashed 3 m line / 6 m gap on urban roads (RO standard SR 1848-7), 0.10–0.15 m wide
markings.centre_line: white continuous (single) on 2-lane two-way, double continuous on 4+ lane two-way without median
markings.zebra: white bars 0.5 m wide / 0.5 m gap, parallel to traffic, no side lines; a few school-zone crossings have red infill between the white bars (verify per crossing on refs)
markings.bus_lane: white continuous line with "BUS" text; since 2019 some STB lanes on Magheru axis/Ștefan cel Mare painted red-brown (#9E3B2E) – verify per street
markings.yellow: yellow only for temporary works and kerb no-parking (zig-zag at bus stops)
markings.wear: markings visibly worn/faded on most streets except freshly resurfaced arteries — use 60–80% opacity

kerbs.material: grey concrete kerbstones 15×25 cm (older streets: granite #8C8C8C), kerb height 12–18 cm, often chipped

sidewalks.paving: mix: (a) grey concrete interlocking pavers ("pavele") #A9A59C on renovated boulevards; (b) cracked asphalt #6E6C68 on side streets; (c) 40×40 grey concrete slabs on 1960–80s estates
sidewalks.parking_on_sidewalk: very common: cars half/fully on the sidewalk on side streets, behind metal bollards on boulevards

traffic_lights.model: RO 3-aspect vehicle heads (200/300 mm), black or yellow housing with yellow-black backplates on main arteries, mounted on grey/black poles + overhead mast arms at big junctions; pedestrian 2-aspect (red/green man) with countdown displays on major junctions

street_name_plates.style: blue plate (#1F4E9A) white text "Bulevardul X" + sector number "Sector 1" in smaller text, on building corners or poles

bus_shelter.style: STB/Clear-channel style glass shelters with grey steel frame and backlit ad panel; many stops have only a pole with the yellow STB stop sign + timetable

metro_totem.style: Metrorex entrance: blue square sign with white "M", station name in white on blue; stairs down with grey stone/steel railings

trolleybus_wires.style: pair of copper contact wires 0.6 m apart per direction at ~5.6 m, carried by span wires between steel or concrete poles on both kerbs (often shared with street lamps)

tram_track.style: standard gauge 1435 mm; on boulevards in a central reservation with concrete sleepers/ballast or grass, kerbed and fenced in places; overhead single contact wire on span wires

lamps.boulevard: galvanised/grey steel octagonal poles 10–12 m, single or double arm, LED or older sodium cobra heads (sodium = orange #FFB45A; LED = 4000 K white #F2F0E6); 25–35 m spacing staggered on both kerbs and often in the median
lamps.side_street: 7–9 m grey poles or concrete poles with single arm, ~30 m spacing
lamps.historic: Calea Victoriei: black ornamental cast-iron style lanterns

trees.species: Tilia (linden, dominant on boulevards), Aesculus hippocastanum (horse chestnut), Acer platanoides, Platanus (plane, older avenues), Robinia pseudoacacia (side streets), Celtis; crown 8–14 m

furniture.bin: grey/green metal municipal litter bins on poles
furniture.bollards: black or grey steel anti-parking posts (~0.9 m) lining boulevard kerbs
furniture.bike: I'Velo green docks at main squares

buildings.ground_floor: shops with mixed signage, many vacant "De închiriat" (for rent) banners; ATM boxes; exchange offices
buildings.air_con: split AC units on facades (very visible)
buildings.cables: loose telecom cables strung between buildings/poles on side streets

gaps: Rosetti facade/era unverified (no licensed photo yet)
School-run congestion is an assumption, not sourced
Villa-by-villa facades on Garibaldi not individually researched

dialogue.format: Each line {text (original language), en (English)}; persona.lang = language of text; `base` refers to bucharest-spots.json dialogue_general.persona_library; categories greeting / bumped / photographed / idle / district (place-specific facts, all consistent with this dossier).

personas.name: Matei (C.A. Rosetti pupil)
personas.desc: High-school student with headphones, walking to Str. Garibaldi.

greeting.en: Hey, are you at Rosetti too?

idle.en: We have a maths test today.
At break we go to the Mega.

idle.text: Simularea la bac e săptămâna viitoare.
idle.en: The mock baccalaureate is next week.

district.text: Garibaldi e cu sens unic, toți părinții se blochează aici dimineața.
district.en: Garibaldi is one-way, all the parents get stuck here in the morning.

district.text: Străzile din jur au nume de compozitori.
district.en: The streets around have composers' names.

district.text: Sky Tower se vede de peste tot.
district.en: You can see Sky Tower from everywhere.

district.text: După ore mergem în Parcul Floreasca.
district.en: After school we go to Floreasca park.

personas.name: Andrei (parent on the school run)
personas.desc: Double-parked with hazards on, dropping a kid off before work.

bumped.text: Scuze, am avariile pornite doar un minut.
bumped.en: Sorry, hazards on just for a minute.

photographed.en: Take the kid's picture, not mine.

photographed.text: Ok, repede, că vine poliția locală.
photographed.en: OK, quick, the local police are coming.

idle.text: Iar e coadă pe Calea Floreasca.
Am ședință la nouă în Pipera.
idle.en: I have a meeting at nine in Pipera.

idle.text: Locul de parcare e un mit aici.
idle.en: A parking space is a myth here.

district.text: Pe Garibaldi nu poți opri, dar toată lumea oprește.
district.en: You can't stop on Garibaldi, but everyone does.

district.text: Până la Barbu Văcărescu fac douăzeci de minute.
district.en: It takes me twenty minutes to Barbu Văcărescu.

district.text: La prânz vin iar s-o iau.
district.en: I come back at lunch to pick her up.

district.text: Piața Floreasca are cele mai bune roșii.
district.en: Piața Floreasca has the best tomatoes.

personas.name: Alex (waiter, Calea Floreasca terrace)
personas.desc: Waiter at one of the restaurants that made Floreasca a food hotspot.

greeting.text: Bună seara, o masă pentru doi?
greeting.en: Good evening, a table for two?

photographed.text: Fă poză la farfurie, e mai fotogenică decât mine.
photographed.en: Photograph the plate, it's more photogenic than me.
Will you leave us a review?

district.text: Floreasca e acum zona cu cele mai multe restaurante noi.
district.en: Floreasca now has the most new restaurants.

district.text: Corporatiștii din Sky Tower vin la prânz.
district.en: The Sky Tower office crowd comes at lunch.

district.text: Lacul e la cinci minute pe jos.
district.en: The lake is five minutes' walk.

personas.name: Domnul Mihai (villa resident)
personas.desc: Retired engineer living in a 1930s villa on a composer street, walking his dog.

greeting.text: Bună ziua, vă pot ajuta cu ceva?
greeting.en: Good day, can I help with something?

photographed.text: Faceți poze la vile, sunt frumoase.
photographed.en: Take pictures of the villas, they're lovely.

photographed.text: Pe mine? Ce să faceți cu un moș?
photographed.en: Me? What would you want with an old man?

photographed.text: Fotografiați și teiul, are o sută de ani.
photographed.en: Photograph the linden too, it's a hundred years old.

idle.en: It used to be quiet here.

idle.text: Au dărâmat vila de vizavi pentru un bloc.
idle.en: They knocked the villa opposite down for a block.

idle.text: Câinele ăsta mă scoate de trei ori pe zi.
idle.en: This dog takes me out three times a day.

district.text: Cartierul a fost parcelat în perioada interbelică.
district.en: The quarter was laid out between the wars.

district.text: Străzile poartă nume de compozitori: Mozart, Chopin, Bach.
district.en: The streets carry composers' names: Mozart, Chopin, Bach.

district.text: Turnul ăla de sticlă, Sky Tower, e cel mai înalt din țară.
district.en: That glass tower, Sky Tower, is the tallest in the country.
In autumn the chestnuts cover the sidewalk.

culture_notes.note: "Bună ziua" with strangers, "Salut/Neața" among young people; "dumneavoastră" (formal you) to older people; "Mersi" is as common as "Mulțumesc".
Bucharest drivers honk readily and often do not stop at zebras; pedestrians answer with sarcasm rather than aggression — keep lines teasing, not violent.
Cars parked on sidewalks are a constant pedestrian complaint; a natural topic for bumped/idle lines in side streets.
At OTP passengers order licensed taxis from touch-screen kiosks in Arrivals; unsolicited offers are a known nuisance — staff lines should point to the kiosks.
Personas are defined by role/place (student, vendor, commuter), never by ethnicity; Roma, Moldovan or diaspora characters are not caricatured; humour targets traffic, weather, parking and the metro.

Generic personas (local_elder, tour_guide …) and the pedestrian_general set (honked_at, near_miss, sidewalk_parking) live in bucharest-spots.json → dialogue_general; district personas below add place-specific lines.
